facts.fact: 朱迪思否认自己去过戈斯莫尔游乐园，坚称几周都没去过
facts.anchor: I’ve not been there for weeks.

facts.fact: 朱迪思否认自己在勒索布伦丹，转而逼他确认两起谋杀用的是同一把枪
facts.anchor: Absolutely not. But just to confirm, to stop us talking to other people

facts.fact: 布伦丹最终松口，承认两起谋杀用的是同一把枪
facts.anchor: It was the same gun,’ he eventually huffed.

facts.fact: 贝克斯用图钉标出加里·怀斯与迈克·萨克森的照片，再用毛线把两案连起来
facts.anchor: wrapped the loose end around the pin in the centre of Gary’s photo

facts.fact: 朱迪思提出加里·怀斯之死与他被人勒索的那件事有关
facts.anchor: Gary Wise was killed in connection with whatever it was he was being blackmailed over.

facts.fact: 朱迪思临开门前先送给两位朋友各自一本填字游戏书，三人一起走到前门
facts.anchor: Suzie and Becks followed, still holding their books.

facts.fact: 门外来的陌生女人自称是电视节目主持人安吉拉·格列佛
facts.anchor: My name’s Angela Gulliver,’ the woman said.

facts.fact: 安吉拉在门口说她们是抓凶手的人，因此怀疑自己会成为下一个受害者
facts.anchor: I think I’m going to be the next victim.
